today.title: Today’s training
today.intro: Record only the sets you confirm. Unreported measurements stay empty.

today.active: In progress · Prescription saved at start

rest.title: Rest

outbox.hint: Offline operations stay in this browser and sync in order. Return to the original account to continue; do not clear browser data. Keep this page open offline; reopening offline is not supported yet.
outbox.startHint: Go online to start and load the plan; then you can record offline.
outbox.login: Sign in to the original account
outbox.conflictHint: Cloud records changed. These {count} local operations are paused. Review them before discarding and recording again; cloud data will not be overwritten automatically.
outbox.noActive: No active workout. See workout history for ended sessions.
outbox.discard: Discard these {count} operations and use cloud records

errors.LOAD_FAILED: Could not load records. Query/recover before continuing.
errors.CONFLICT: Records changed or this operation is no longer valid. Later operations are paused. Query/recover to review differences.
errors.UNKNOWN: Save outcome unknown; the operation is retained. We will retry the same request online before sending later operations.
errors.AUTH: Sign-in expired or the account changed. Sign in to the original account and retry; pending operations are retained.
errors.LOCAL_CONFLICT: Records changed. This operation was not queued. Query/recover and review before trying again.
errors.STORAGE: Browser storage failed; the operation was not queued. Keep this page open and check storage permissions or space before reopening today’s card.
errors.HISTORY_FAILED: Saved, but history could not refresh. Please query/recover.

sentence.title: Log in one sentence
sentence.hint: Preview local rules offline, then confirm to queue. The server validates again when syncing. Unreported actuals stay unknown.
sentence.previewFailed: Could not load a draft. Please parse again.
sentence.endHint: End this workout? Unreported sets will remain unreported.
sentence.unknown: — means unreported; RPE never defaults to the target.
sentence.receiptHint: Latest 20. Undo adds a compensation record and never overwrites later edits.

clarify.invalid_context: Context changed. Query/recover and parse again.
clarify.input_length: Report actual training in up to 400 characters.
clarify.not_unambiguous_actuals: This contains planned, negative or uncertain information. Report only what you did.
clarify.repeat_needs_explicit_fields: State the reps and any known weight; “same again” is not enough.
clarify.exercise_not_unique: Use the exact exercise name or select an exercise.
clarify.correction_unsupported: Use “correct Squat set 2 to 7 reps”. Edit other fields in the set form.
clarify.correction_target_not_unique: No unique completed set found. Specify the exercise and set number.
clarify.skip_target_not_unique: Specify the exercise and set to skip.
clarify.set_unavailable: These slots are occupied, voided or exceed this session. Correct an existing set or choose available slots.
clarify.out_of_range: Check the values and number of sets; they exceed the supported range.
clarify.unsupported_or_missing_unit: Specify kg/lb, or just “8 reps”. Use the set form for unsupported sentences.
clarify.rpe_scope_ambiguous: Which sets does RPE describe? Say “last set RPE 9” or “each set RPE 8”.

replacement.scope: This session only. Your long-term plan stays unchanged.
replacement.hasHistory: This exercise has recorded, skipped or voided sets and cannot be replaced.
replacement.equipmentHint: Select only equipment you can use now. Unselected equipment is unavailable.
replacement.unknown: This exercise could not be identified uniquely. Keep it or arrange your own alternative; no replacement is guessed.
replacement.none: No candidate meets these equipment requirements.
replacement.prescription: Keep targets: {sets} sets × {reps} reps · RPE {rpe} (prescription only).
replacement.actuals: Actual weight, reps and RPE start blank. Record what you do. Candidates do not imply equivalent loads or training effects.
replacement.stale: The session changed or could not be saved. Cancel and preview again.
replacement.pending: Pending sync: saved on this device
replacement.undoBlocked: This session ended, the exercise changed again, or it has set history. This replacement cannot be undone.
replacement.undoPreview: Restore “{name}” for this session only. Actuals stay blank and old requests stay invalid.

coach.title: Agent
coach.intro: Describe this workout. Review a draft before saving.
coach.welcome: Ask “show plan”, or say “{exercise} 50 kg 10,10,8, last set RPE 9”. I will prepare a draft for you to confirm before saving.
coach.mode: Local rules mode · Open-ended Q&A is not supported yet
coach.temporary: Chat stays on this page only; confirmed records can be recovered from receipts.

replies.help: Ask about your weight, meals and training, or add an entry. Enable natural conversation to create or adjust plans too. Say “start workout” to choose a day or “show receipts” to review saved changes.
replies.noSession: Say “start workout” to choose a day in this conversation before logging sets. You can query or add body and meal records without starting a workout.
replies.invalid: Use 1–400 characters to ask a question or describe an entry.
replies.plan: These are the plan targets saved when this session started, not actual results:
replies.progress: These are the current records, including locally queued operations:
replies.receipts: Records and sync status are listed below. Choose a specific receipt to undo; I will not guess which one you mean.
replies.longTerm: Use the plan page for long-term plans. This chat only changes the current session.
replies.replace: Select the exercise and available equipment, then preview and confirm. Your long-term plan stays unchanged.
replies.draft: Here is the draft. Nothing has been saved yet. Please check it before confirming:
replies.closed: This draft was closed without submitting. Send the message again if needed.
replies.queued: The operation is in this device’s queue. Check the sync status and receipts below to see whether it has reached the server.
replies.failed: The operation did not complete. Check the sync message, then send again.

coach.stale: The workout changed. This draft cannot be confirmed. Send again for a new draft.
coach.chooseToContinue: Which exercise does this refer to? Choose one to prepare a new draft.
coach.chooseReplace: Choose the session exercise. Exercises with set history cannot be replaced.
coach.example: For example: {exercise} 50 kg 10,10,8, last set RPE 9
coach.enterHint: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line
coach.snapshot: Snapshot at the time of this question. Ask again after changes. Unreported values display as —.
coach.receiptHint: Saved entries keep their source and undo history. Pending entries have not been confirmed by the cloud.
coach.emptyReceipts: No receipts yet. Confirmed drafts will appear here.
